subject: a wet road curving around green hills
art_direction: 一条湿润山路从底部绕过青绿坡面，远山在柔白雾中慢慢退去。
visible_description: 一条湿润山路从底部绕过青绿坡面，远山在柔白雾中慢慢退去。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Paint a narrow wet road curving from the bottom left around a soft green hillside. A thin silver reflection follows its inner edge, while distant hills retreat into pale mist. Keep roadside plants simple and the scene empty of vehicles or signs. Use gentle animated-background brushwork and diffused daylight, emphasizing peaceful continuation and open atmospheric depth. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
